title: Normalized transported actual Roos complex computes the strict derived quotient limit
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l and X any scheme. Use the exact transport F to O-modules [def-sfb-internal-completion-section-transport] and complexIso(P), quotientComplex(P), quotientLimitUnit(P) [def-sfb-internal-quotient-tower-model]. For every actual integral complex P [sk-def-pe-derived-completion] and every total right derived inverse-limit functor RF on O-module towers with comparison c invertible on K-injective towers [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit], there is an isomorphism e: F(Q(actualRoos(P))) ≅ RF(Q(quotientComplex(P))). Its composite with F(Q(actualAugmentation(P))) is complexIso(P).hom followed by Q(quotientLimitUnit(P)) followed by c at quotientComplex(P). No generator, regularity, K-flatness, Koszul complex or completion presentation occurs.

proof.text: Transpose the actual quotient tower using the existing complex/functor equivalence. Functor.ofOpSequence_map_homOfLE_succ identifies its successor maps with levelStep, so its Roos endomorphism is exactly oneSubShift. The already proved genericCoconeIso identifies the explicit differential (dx,(1-s)x-dy) with the shifted cone. Compute the two coordinates of the image of augmentation: the ordinary product unit and zero. Thus its composite with the source isomorphism is exactly roosAugment of the actual level units.

The ordinary functor modules is additive and preserves countable products: scalar restriction commutes with the underlying-object forgetful functors which compute and reflect limits, and smallModules is the existing section equivalence. Apply the proved canonical roosAdditiveComparison and roosAdditiveComparison_isIso. Prove the mapped-tower/transpose interchange generically before specializing the coefficient functor; its target is definitionally quotientComplex. The proved augmentation coordinate identity, followed by extensionality in roosχ, identifies the transported actual augmentation with roosAugment of the mapped level units.

Obtain exact countable products for internal modules from the proved pro-etale repleteness/epimorphic-tower theorem, Mod.epiπAppZeroOfEpi and CountableAB4Star.of_epi_π_app_zero, and transport exactness along the existing smallModules equivalence. The module-sheaf Grothendieck theorem and the proved roos_tower_grothendieck argument give K-injective tower resolutions. Use the already proved generic normalizedRoosIso helper of CoefficientConstantTowerRoosComparison with the supplied c, transported across strictTowerLimitIso. Its hypothesis holds because c is invertible on K-injectives. Its normalization states Q(roosι) followed by the comparison is Q(strictTowerLimitIso.hom) followed by c.

The limit universal property proves that roosAugmentLimit of the transported units followed by strictTowerLimitIso.hom is quotientLimitUnit: after each degreewise limit projection both maps equal the specified quotient unit. Factor roosAugment through roosAugmentLimit and roosι and apply the normalized comparison equation. Finally naturality of the exact-functor localization factors defining complexIso transports the source augmentation equation. Compose complexIso at the actual Roos complex, the localized transported Roos isomorphism, and the normalized derived-limit isomorphism. This is e and yields exactly the displayed equation. All constructions and identities are functorial and also apply to zero complexes and the empty scheme.

lean.statement:
theorem quotient_roos_limit
    (P : CochainComplex (AdicCompletion.Modules l E X) ℤ)
    (RF : DerivedCategory (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ConstantCompletion.Mod (ring l E X)) ⥤
      ConstantCompletion.D (ring l E X))
    (c : (lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ConstantCompletion.Mod (ring l E X)) ⥤ _).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ RF)
    (hc : RF.IsRightDerivedFunctor c
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ConstantCompletion.Mod (ring l E X)) (.up ℤ)))
    (hI : ∀ I, CochainComplex.IsKInjective I → IsIso (c.app I)) :
    ∃ e : (functor l E X).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (AdicCompletion.roos l E X P)) ≅
        RF.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (quotientComplex l E X P)),
      (functor l E X).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (AdicCompletion.augmentation l E X P)) ≫
        e.hom = (complexIso l E X P).hom ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (quotientLimitUnit l E X P) ≫
            c.app (quotientComplex l E X P)
